items.title: Is Philip Morris International (PM) Fairly Valued On State Street’s Latest ETF Buy?
items.summary: Philip Morris International (PM) is back in focus after State Street’s Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF, XLP, lifted its exposure by US$25.2 million on November 9, 2026, following earlier reductions.
